What separates a top 1% entrepreneur
from a top 0.1% entrepreneur? >> Most entrepreneurs think about strategy
the way they think about what they want to make for dinner. And so, they will go
to the refrigerator, open it up, and say, "What's inside of here? Let me see
what I can whip up." Rather than opening their hands and looking up and saying
like, "What the do I want to eat?" And then go to the grocery store, going
out to eat, and looking at all the potential options that exist. Strategy
is the curation and prioritization of opportunities. And so, the curation part
is that most of them are looking just with their head in the fridge and
looking at six options. So, you have to be able to see all the potentialities.
And then when you have all the potentials, the prioritization it says
of all things, which of these is the most important? And I think this is this
is where you get your 100x differences in entrepreneurs.
